pull_request.title: Calorimeter: compare matched 10k LAr and Si-W electron responses
pull_request.head: codex/lar-10k-response-comparison
pull_request.body:
Resume the user-requested matched 10,000-electron ALLEGRO-style LAr versus Si-W raw-response study after merged #139. Task `TASK-LAR10K-RESPONSE-COMPARISON`; governing geometry DES030–033. The prospective protocol is `docs/validation/lar10k/protocol.md`.

Both geometries use the same original electron primaries, E=10–80 GeV, eta −3…3, full phi, ECAL-only B=0, FTFP_BERT and 0.7 mm cuts. The LAr run uses the maintained reusable-period default. The previous failed pilot is retained. Serial preinitialization addresses its first-hit native volume-map race; serial/MT controls and native-limit/5 mm pilots precede production.

This draft is in progress: production transport and final result assessment are pending. Analysis will retain all events and zeros, raw response means/widths/tails, angular and energy controls, shared-event bootstrap intervals and covariance. No calibrated resolution, digitization, technology selection or engineering acceptance is implied.

The comparison now rejects wrong detector/production policies and rehashes actual worker/ROOT evidence. Five focused analysis controls pass. Runtime imports and datasets have been reverified. Full XML/ROOT/event/log payloads remain local and ignored; compact statistics and figures will accompany the completed study.

Coordinator/SoftEng/PhysVal contracts and outcomes are curated in `SESSION-2026-11-13-lar10k-resume`. Exact active-parent counters remain excluded; closed observations will be recorded when available.
